name: colQuantiles
title: Estimates quantiles for each column in a matrix

origin.description: Estimates quantiles for each row (column) in a matrix.
origin.usage:
colQuantiles(x, rows = NULL, cols = NULL, probs = seq(from = 0, to = 1,
  by = 0.25), na.rm = FALSE, type = 7L, digits = 7L, ...,
  useNames = TRUE, drop = TRUE)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An integer, numeric, or logical N by K matrix with N >= 0.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.text: A vector indicating a subset of rows to operate over. If NULL, no subsetting is done.

arguments.name: cols
arguments.text: A vector indicating a subset of columns to operate over. If NULL, no subsetting is done.

arguments.name: probs
arguments.text: A numeric vector of J probabilities in [0, 1].

arguments.name: na.rm
arguments.text: If TRUE, missing values are excluded.

arguments.name: type
arguments.text: An integer specifying the type of estimator. See stats::quantile.

arguments.name: digits
arguments.text: An integer specifying the precision of the formatted percentages. Not used when useNames is FALSE.
Additional arguments passed to stats::quantile. fuzz is the one used by quantile.

arguments.name: useNames
arguments.text: If TRUE (default), names attributes of the result are set, otherwise not.

arguments.name: drop
arguments.text: If TRUE, singleton dimensions in the result are dropped, otherwise not.

origin.details: Same estimator as rowQuantiles, applied down each column. A column with a missing value is NA when na.rm is FALSE.
origin.value: A K by J matrix, where K is the number of selected columns and J is the number of probabilities. A single column or a single probability drops to a vector when drop is TRUE.

translation.description: Estimates quantiles for each column in a matrix.
translation.usage:
colQuantiles(x, rows=None, cols=None, probs=None, na_rm=False, type=7,
  digits=7, use_names=True, drop=True, fuzz=None)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An N by K array. Axis 0 is rows and axis 1 is columns. Integer, floating, and logical arrays are accepted.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.text: 1-based rows to include. None uses every row.

arguments.name: cols
arguments.text: 1-based columns to include. None uses every column.

arguments.name: probs
arguments.text: Probabilities. None is 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, and 1.

arguments.name: na_rm
arguments.text: If true, missing values are dropped. A double missing value is nan. An integer missing value is -2147483648.

arguments.name: type
arguments.text: Quantile type 1 through 9. The default 7 matches stats::quantile.

arguments.name: digits
arguments.text: Precision of the percentage names. Ignored when use_names is false.

arguments.name: use_names
arguments.text: If true, .colnames holds names such as 25% and 75%.

arguments.name: drop
arguments.text: If true, a result with one column or one probability becomes a one-dimensional array.

arguments.name: fuzz
arguments.text: Passed to the stats::quantile path. None uses R's default.

translation.details: The matrix is transposed and the row estimator is applied, so each original column is one result row. Names and types match rowQuantiles.
translation.value: An array of shape (selected columns, probabilities), with the same storage rules as rowQuantiles.
translation.example:
import numpy as np
from matrixstats.rowquantiles import colQuantiles

colQuantiles(np.arange(1, 13).reshape((4, 3), order="F"), probs=[0.25, 0.75])
